description:
Regenerate an API key: issues a new key (a new id and secret) with the same name, environment, scopes and sub-account. The old key stops working immediately; use the id in this response from now on. The new key lists the old one in replaced_key_ids, so its requests and usage stay with it. The new secret is returned ONLY in this response. Note: the secret will be visible in the AI conversation context.

Agent usage: This operation requires 2FA. Before calling, complete the 2FA flow: (1) call start_2fa with action_type "api_key_regenerate", (2) wait for user to verify the code, (3) poll get_2fa_status until "verified", (4) then call regenerate_api_key.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Set PROOF_API_KEY and restart this server, or sign in with start_login — a session opens this tool — then call this tool again.
name: regenerate_api_key

outputSchema.description: A newly created or regenerated API key, with its full value — the one response that carries it.

key.description: The full API key. Returned only in this response; it cannot be read again.

profile_id.description: Sub-account (PublicProfile) the key is bound to; null for unbound keys.
